cryptographic_fixture.source: HMAC-SHA256 over canonically encoded exact observed Action payload, independent source key
cryptographic_fixture.grant: separate independent HMAC-SHA256 exact scoped grant, fresh random nonce
cryptographic_fixture.limitations: shared-secret toy, not public-key/prod multi-process attestation; no cross-process replay prevention without persisted authoritative grant state

mainline: explicit fixture retention and unchanged PersistentCognition save/load with source and integration provenance; read-only projection imports only mainline types
sidecar: JSON canonical, exact keys, duplicate key rejection, fresh Python objects reverified without relying on object identity
handoff: schema-only LRN/HABIT projection with exactly two observed action receipts, candidate ref and source IDs; no real S10/S11/S17 calls, no Action issuance or retention mutation
negative_controls: wrong target or source IDs/action candidate
silent same-revision mismatch after new observed Action
result: SERIALIZED_SOURCE_AND_EXPLICIT_HANDOFF_GATE_QUALIFIED only within the offline fixture, else NO_WITNESS_NO_HANDOFF/UNDETERMINED
